name: Exusiai
description: Exusiai's kit from Arknights for your Helldiver: Charging Mode (her next shots hit harder), summoned guns that fire with her, and Overloading Mode (four more guns, each picking its own target), with Fast Cartridge (faster-firing guns) and Angel's Blessings (more health and damage). Solo or host. Keys in exusiai.ini; every number also on the escape menu's MODS tab (Mod Options Menu). HUD (needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime): skills beside the stratagem list. No character model included.
